CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010 Layer 2. Drift detector: TRUE when the stored stamp disagrees with the live parent cascade value, so staleness is reportable rather than silent. A blank stamp against a populated parent counts as drift.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISBLANK( ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date_Stamp__c ), ISBLANK( Quote.ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c ) ), FALSE, ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date_Stamp__c <> Quote.ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when the stamped Day 1 ARR start date no longer matches the parent quote.
CustomField.label: Day 1 ARR Start Date Drift
